dedupe_keys.name: verknet bwastr topological network of germany s federal waterways with kilometre stationing and waterway classes wsv

description: The Verkehrsnetz der Bundeswasserstraßen (VerkNet-BWaStr) is the uniform national transport network of Germany's federal waterways, maintained by the Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung des Bundes (WSV) through its geodesy and geoinformatics unit FGeoWSV. Contents: a topologically connected vector dataset of all federal waterways with their names and identification numbers, kilometre stationing, waterway classes, the links between sections, and layers for the administrative districts of the waterways directorate (GDWS) branches and the waterways and shipping offices; it is the georeferencing base that ties all WSV technical data (locks, weirs, gauges, structures) to waterway stations. Coverage: all federal inland and maritime waterways of Germany; the catalogue entry was refreshed in September 2026, and the dataset is listed under the EU high-value datasets regulation 2023/138. Format and access: a routing WFS, WMS, WMTS and TMS tile services on via.bund.de, catalogued on GovData and Mobilithek. Licence: Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0 (dl-zero-de/2.0); free. Caveats: the services deliver network geometry and stationing, not lock dimensions or traffic; bulk file downloads were not seen, so the WFS is the download route. Simulation uses: inland navigation network for freight network flow models, criticality of locks and waterway sections under low water or floods, and hazard exposure along rivers. Related records: the Mobilithek portal (data-mobilithek) lists the same services.
